name: Doom Of Sundering
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 2, druid/shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one non-magical weapon
Duration 1 round/level; see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Your weapon glows with otherworldly flames. The damage you inflict on your foe is also applied as object damage to your opponent’s weapon hp; with each strike, they see their wooden or iron weapon slowly crumbling into sawdust or rust, driving some foes to panick or despair. Magic weapons are immune to this spell.

Weapon hardness still applies.

Mythic: By spending a use of mythic power, you make magical weapons susceptible to this effect.
